example.title: Northern Hotel, 428 Jackson Street
example.source: HABS WI-282 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,37-WASA,1-)

brief: Brick two-and-a-half-storey Second Empire hotel of 1883: a patterned mansard roof with a row of pedimented dormers over a central pavilion, round-arched upper windows with light brick hoods and a fire escape down the middle. The ground floor has been reclad in plain panels under a shingled pent roof with two doors and small windows; it stands alone on a corner with open lots beside it.
